topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Well, it's not often the soil yields such a surprise, but there you have it. Young Toby, back from the city, brought me a parcel bound with twine. Inside, a book of herbs and their uses, finer than any I've seen. The pages are smoothed and the hand that wrote the notes inside is steady and clear. It brings a warm thought to my chest, thinking of the years I spent teaching him, how he always had a knack for knowing just what would grow best where. I remember telling him, "The earth has a way of giving back more than you ask." Seems he's been paying it forward, and it’s a sweet reminder of the seeds we sow.
